_WARNING_do_not_cite_as_a_bound.defect: These out-of-fold values were fitted with sklearn KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True) -- ROW-LEVEL folds, no grouping on pair, molecule or source. The cross-fitted quantity E[(m - rhat(z*))^2] is an upper bound on B_insuff = E[Var(m | z*)] only when rhat is independent of the held-out row's label; with ungrouped folds on clustered data that independence fails, the cross term goes negative, and the estimate can fall BELOW B_insuff. So rf_oof_upper = 0.5645747528001114 is NOT certified to be an upper bound and must not be cited as one.
_WARNING_do_not_cite_as_a_bound.evidence: Ground-truth synthetic validation matched to the real design (results/b_insuff/crossfit_synthetic_validation.json, from scripts/analysis/run_b_insuff_crossfit_synthetic_validation.py): with pair- or source-grouped folds, 0 of 636 cells fall below known truth across the declared headline scope; with row-level folds, 9.4% fall below truth in the realistic regime (B_insuff/Var(m) <= 0.30) and 71.9% at 0.60, and in the null design (m independent of z*) row-level folds return 1.73 and 1.42 against a truth of 4.851 -- 64% and 71% below -- while reporting out-of-fold R^2 of +0.61 and +0.64. Numerical gates do not catch it; only the fold-integrity assertion does.
_WARNING_do_not_cite_as_a_bound.exposure_on_this_set: These 60 VT-2005-matched rows carry 60 distinct molecule pairs, so the pair channel is empty here; but 60 rows carry 41 solutes and 17 solvents, so every held-out row still shares a molecule with training rows. On the broad IDAC set the pair channel is open outright (359 of 477 rows share a pair with another row), and blocking that leak moves the same forest from 0.15 to 0.88.
_WARNING_do_not_cite_as_a_bound.what_the_paper_uses_instead: Nothing in the manuscript rests on these values. The headline B_insuff upper bound is the law-of-total-variance coarsening (8 equal-count bins of g(z*), Bessel within-bin variance); the bounds inventory carries the audit artifact's forest (0.621), not this one. The properly grouped cross-fitted estimator is deposited in results/b_insuff/crossfit_map.json and is LOOSER than the coarsening (0.8557 vs 0.7043 res / 0.4890 full on the broad set), which is reported as a negative result in the Supporting Information.
